domain: action-conditioned world-model PTQ, first screened on DINO-WM Wall
user_direction: 在固定 W4 deployment 下，用 baseline quantizer 自己造成的 residual direction 检验 quantized one-step map 的误差传播；联合校准 scalar scale/rounding，固定 bit map，不做 mixed precision saliency。
bottleneck: Local output reconstruction、QDrop/input-noise 和常规 prediction-difference 只约束 clean 输入或随机扰动；它们没有检验部署时 W4 quantizer 自身在完整 history state 上如何 transport 一个已经出现的 residual。候选把这个问题收窄为有限差分 transport prediction：同一个 history/action 下，Q 与 FP 对冻结 Q0 residual direction 的增量响应是否不同，并且该差异是否比 local MSE 更能预测 held-out closed-loop physical xy drift。

closest_adjacent.name: AdaRound
closest_adjacent.delta: data/task-aware rounding but layer-local reconstruction; candidate uses its hard-rounding route with transport loss

closest_adjacent.name: QDrop
closest_adjacent.delta: randomly drops activation quantization; candidate uses fixed self-induced residual, with QDrop/input-noise as control

closest_adjacent.name: PD-Quant
closest_adjacent.delta: global FP/Q prediction difference plus regularization/distribution correction; candidate compares finite-difference transport around x

closest_adjacent.name: GAD
closest_adjacent.delta: JVP sensitivity alignment in T2I distillation; candidate is frozen PTQ and must beat or be separated from random same-norm delta

closest_adjacent.name: DA-PTQ
closest_adjacent.delta: virtual-Jacobian and motion-driven mixed precision; candidate uses actual Q0 residual direction and fixed W4 joint scale/rounding

closest_adjacent.name: QuantWAMs
closest_adjacent.delta: shared-basis/Fisher/reachable-state audit and WAM schedule repair; DINO candidate has no denoising schedule and does not reuse that endpoint

gap: 在 fixed W4 PTQ 下，量化器对已发生的 deployment-induced residual 方向的 finite-difference transport 是否包含超出 clean reconstruction、isotropic noise 和 direct two-step matching 的信息，且能预测 held-out physical closed-loop drift？
lineage: local reconstruction PTQ -> AdaRound/QDrop/PD-Quant parameter fitting -> derivative/JVP sensitivity collateral (Sobolev/GAD) -> frozen deployment-induced residual transport contrast
scope_boundary: 首个 anchor 只量化 DINO-WM Wall predictor 的注册 target blocks；encoder、policy/readout 和 environment 保持 FP32，避免把 encoder/state mismatch 与 predictor transport 混在一起。先固定同一 W4 logical map，联合优化每个 target block 的 scalar scale 与标准 AdaRound hard rounding；不做 W4/W8 map ranking、不做 online observer、不做 QAT/distillation。

assumptions.text: DINO-WM runner 能在完整 history state X 上提供纯函数 one-step map F(X,a)，而 environment rollout 能独立读取 physical xy/goal endpoint；不要求 latent 到 xy 的线性 readout。缺少 full history 或 one-step map 即停止。
FP32 与 frozen Q0 在相同 history/action/RNG 下可重放；delta 只写入预测的新 latent slot，其余 history 保持不变。
transport contrast 对 held-out closed-loop drift 的预测比 local MSE/随机同范数方向更有用；不假设 quantization noise 小，也不把 finite difference 当作严格线性/Jacobian。
全体 scalar scale/rounding 以一个 joint objective 优化，不把 site score 相加；同一 W4 map、相同 logical bytes 和无 deployment-side state 是比较前提。

not_addressed_by_phase0: Q0 residual direction 是否比 isotropic/random same-norm perturbation 携带更多 transport information；stakes: 若没有，方法只是 GAD-like noise sensitivity regularization。
冻结 delta 是否能在 calibration 后用 fresh Q0 residual，并用拟合后一次 fresh Qtheta residual 做 DEV 验证，而不让优化把自身 residual 变小；stakes: 防止 calibration leakage/自证循环。
joint scalar map 是否在同一 logical W4 bytes 下稳定改善 physical xy drift；stakes: 防止 AdaRound/PD-Quant 的 clean prediction gain 被误写成 closed-loop deployment gain。
falsification_gate: 若 random same-norm delta 与 Q0 delta 的 DEV transport/TEST drift 等效，或 transport loss 与 local MSE/2-step matching 的预测排序不稳定，或 joint fitting 没有超出 matched local controls 的 downstream gain，则候选 no-go；不以 CAL clean loss 单独放行。
retrieval_mode: Phase 0 real connector pool was bounded/degraded; this revision adds a small primary web full-text supplement for AdaRound/QDrop/PD-Quant/Sobolev/GAD. Novelty remains conditional and not independently certified.
